title: Associated-module presentation of a coherent sheaf on an affine scheme
statement: Let X be affine Noetherian and H a coherent module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. There exists a module P over A=Γ(X,⊤) and an isomorphism from tilde(P) [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] pulled back along the canonical X≅Spec A to H.

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence. Restrict H to Spec of the global section ring; quasi-coherence is preserved by restriction. Take its module of sections P.

The tilde counit for the restricted quasi-coherent sheaf is an isomorphism. Restrict back, compose the restriction-composition and identity isomorphisms, and replace restriction along the chart by pullback.

mathlib_searches.query: affine coherent formal modules inverse limit tensor completion naturality
A morphism of coherent formal modules on an affine scheme is a linear map over the adic completion
mathlib_searches.results: Scheme.Modules.Hom, ModuleCat.tilde, AdicCompletion.of and AdicCompletion.map; no sheaf-to-limit morphism dictionary

CoherentFormalModulesAffine supplies equivalence and limit cones only on Spec; CoherentFormalModuleAnnihilated supplies bounds on actual section-limit maps. CompletionInternalHomAffineTensorDictionary concerns internal Hom evaluation, not a general formal source.
The affine counit is the relevant existing construction; its quasi-coherent isomorphism instance is used directly.

theorem affine_coherent_tilde_presentation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsAffine X] (H : CoherentModules X) :
    ∃ P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤),
      Nonempty ((tilde.functor Γ(X, ⊤) ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom).obj P ≅ H.obj)
